## 1. Actual activation and merge

- [Real owner activation comment](https://github.com/wlvh/SEC_metrics/pull/32#issuecomment-5560878827); unedited author `wlvh`, read back from GitHub and checked by the existing transition validator.

- PR32 merged as `f6117862093c78865be0f112cdf8a264f202ca27`. Its tree `0b6b65fc10f8b090447e2c256b70fd2311d0c065` equals the reviewed tree; approved head `0605a312710cd3347b6b67d94c805faeb045a846` is a direct merge parent.
- Frozen snapshots and their NOT_ACTIVATED bytes were not rewritten. Activation is represented by the real, separately validated receipt. No approval loop was introduced by a receipt commit.

- [Complete CLI plan bytes](docs/r4_v3_live/pending_plan_review.json); byte-identical to the runtime plan under `artifacts/vnext/qualification/r4_scoped/plans/`.
- Release head: `8a34f3601570a056b2d00a19728e08915a783a11`; tree: `c1284abac9521f80a491561bbea1d50bc98d7c7a`. Subsequent commits contain data only; no production Python differs from the implementation merge.
- Exactly 9 base + 3 fresh stability = 12. Retry=0, reuse=false, SEC=false, publication=false. Three structured positives and four exclusion classes remain zero-call.

## 4. Actual plan difference review

[Preparation/difference verification](docs/r4_v3_live/preparation_verification.json) binds the actual merge, activation and generated plan.

Sources, exact target locators, full DerivedAsset/ReaderInputManifest, task/Spec bytes, periods, scope/reference values, risk selection and schedule match the previous approved choices. All twelve entry IDs and all nine unique provider request hashes are new. The first request hash matches the merged normal-path regression's new request. No previous model response or old grant is used.

The CLI independently verified the current source/Requirement bindings and active R3 → R2 → R1 chain plus 14 mirrors. This source read-back is not model qualification or publication.

## 5. Changed files

- `docs/evidence/issue_28_v3_transition_activation.json`
- `docs/r4_v3_live/pending_plan_review.json`

This PR adds no Python, policy, Spec, source acquisition, WB-7/R5/R6/Rf feature or new acceptance mechanism.

## 6. Validation and evidence boundaries

- Transition receipt: actual GitHub author/body/timestamp/head checked; native validator PASS.
- Merge: exact reviewed tree, direct approved parent and main ancestry verified.
- Existing CLI plan generation: PASS; actual provider/paid/SEC=0/0/0.
- Field and byte difference review: PASS; expected identity changes only.
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tools/check_capability_contract_alignment.py --base-ref f6117862093c78865be0f112cdf8a264f202ca27`: PASS, structural evidence only.
- Reviewed implementation tests and its successful fast CI are reused because merge tree/code bytes are identical. No long suite or benchmark was repeated. This PR's CI is separate from that evidence.

Actual usage: NOT_RUN. Qualification, staging, publish/rollback/restore: NOT_RUN. No execution/reservation namespace exists for this plan. Active remains R3.

## 8. Historical preservation

PR31 and its original FAILED_TERMINAL execution remain historical and unmerged. The original OPEN Run/reservation archive is unchanged. Historical provider/paid/SEC count remains 1/1/0; this preparation adds 0/0/0. If all twelve future calls occur, cumulative provider/paid calls are thirteen, including the preserved failure. That cumulative number is not a grant.

R4 completion still does not end the project: WB-7, R5, R6 and Rf remain toward 39 unified production metrics and old semantic-producer retirement.
